Group rides in Kentucky

7 recurring group rides around Kentucky: 6 social, 3 road, 1 gravel. 6 roll on weeknights, 0 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Pedal Power x Country Boy Community Bike Ride in Lexington — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Ridenfaden Wednesday runs no-drop group and a fast group.
